rule: PREREG_R9 5.3 / 5.4 = PREREG_R8 5.3 / 5.4 = PREREG_R7 5.3 / 5.4 for incumbent episodes, applied to every episode with at least one round-9 candidate (role screen, reuse8 or reuse7): a candidate is S-eligible iff its export is ok, it has 3 ok official runs, none flagged by the own-input gate, and own-input SP-SR = MP-SR = 1 in >= 2 of them; cons_S = float64 mean of its 3 consensus-B AUCs; finalist = the S-eligible candidate with the highest cons_S among those with cons_S >= m_P_frozen + 0.01 (exact floats); ties: lower population variance of the 3 consensus AUCs, lower mean consensus MPPE, job name; barred candidates are never finalists; at most one finalist per episode. Round-8 / round-7 phase-S results are reused as recorded (roles reuse8 / reuse7).

why_not: reused round-6 finalist with the phase-F verdict 'no replacement' against the same incumbent (PREREG_R7 5.4): not a finalist again
